TYSONS CORNER, Va. and PETAH TIKVA, Israel, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cellebrite (Nasdaq: CLBT), a global leader in Digital Investigative and Intelligence solutions for the public and private sectors, today announced the next evolution of the Digital Justice Awards, known as the JUSTYS. The 2027 program introduces more rigorous judging criteria, an elevated panel of judges and new crime-specific categories for its Case of the Year awards. The JUSTYS will be presented on Tuesday, April 13, 2027, during Cellebrite's annual C2C User Summit which attracts the best and brightest in public safety, law enforcement, defense and intelligence agencies and businesses from around the world.
Now entering its third year, the

is designed to honor the people and teams protecting communities, delivering justice to victims and survivors, holding wrongdoers accountable and exonerating the innocent. While some of the casework and investigative prowess highlighted at the JUSTYS involve high-profile investigations, many do not. Regardless of whether the case generates international acclaim, it's often the quiet, tenacious and under-the-radar work performed by these professionals that help make our world safer.

"The JUSTYS is the crown jewel of our signature global C2C User Summit, and we are honored to give these professionals the recognition they deserve. They are heroes in the communities they serve and we are proud to recognize, honor and shine a light on all the good they do," said Cellebrite Chief Marketing Officer David Gee. "The energy at the conference is palpable and the JUSTYS is a magical evening. We cannot wait for April to roll out the orange carpet and celebrate all the nominees in Dallas!"
, which cover the most gripping and breaking criminal cases making headlines around the world, returns for another year as host of the JUSTYS. The ceremony will once again stream live on

, reaching the network's 7.7 million subscribers and extending recognition of the honorees' work to a global audience. Law&Crime is the leading multi-platform destination for true crime and legal content. Following its acquisition of Court TV in February of this year, Law&Crime is now home to the iconic brand that pioneered live trial coverage in America. Together, Law&Crime and Court TV deliver gavel-to-gavel courtroom proceedings, expert legal analysis, investigative reporting, award-winning documentaries and original programming from a team of award-winning journalists and legal experts.

JUSTYS winners are selected by judges who are leading industry experts guided by rigorous criteria. Every nomination will be judged across three pillars, Digital Forensic & Investigative Excellence, Investigative Impact and Integrity and Ethics, and is evaluated independently before judges arrive at an overall assessment – a structure designed so that a perfect score is rare and meaningful. The judging panel has also expanded to include former JUSTYS Case of the Year winners and select digital forensics and investigative experts, bringing outside perspective and deeper technical scrutiny to every nomination.

The Case of the Year award now has four categories, including Crimes Against Children & Human Trafficking, Narcotics, Major Crimes and Protecting Nations. In addition, the JUSTYS recognize excellence across the digital forensics and investigations community. Every category below is judged to the same demanding standard and only nominations that demonstrate clear, measurable impact rise to the top:

children: Cellebrite's (Nasdaq: CLBT) mission is to protect communities, nations and businesses as a global leader in digital investigative and intelligence solutions. More than 7,000 global law enforcement agencies, defense and intelligence organizations and enterprises trust Cellebrite's AI-powered software portfolio to make forensically sound digital data more accessible and actionable. Cellebrite technology allows customers to accelerate nearly 3 million legally sanctioned investigations annually, enhance sovereign security, elevate operational efficacy and efficiency, and enable advanced mobile research and application security. Available via cloud, on-premises and hybrid deployments, Cellebrite's technology enables its customers around the globe to advance their missions, elevate public safety and safeguard data privacy.
